_meta.description: Natural-language IT equipment requests with the outcome each should get under IT-EQ-100 rev A. The agent reads item and request_type from the text. Evaluation date: 2026-11-23.

requests.text: My MacBook is over 3 years old and local Kubernetes builds are crawling. Can I get my laptop refresh?

expected.reason: In use since 2023-08-14 (39 months); refresh is every 36 months.

requests.text: Laptop has been feeling slow lately, can I get a new one?

expected.reason: In use since 2024-02-05 (33 months); 36-month refresh. Eligible from 2027-02-05.

requests.text: While I wait, can I just do my work on my personal MacBook? It's faster.

expected.reason: Personal laptops may not be used for company work.

requests.text: I'm primary on-call for the database team starting next rotation. Can I get a company phone for PagerDuty?

expected.reason: On-call is true and no company phone on file.

requests.text: Can I get a company phone? I'm on a lot of customer calls.

expected.reason: Company phones are for on-call staff; employee is not on call.

requests.text: I'd like the 16-inch MacBook Pro with 64GB for my demos, the Air struggles with the demo environment.

expected.reason: Engineering-tier laptop is above the account executive's standard tier; needs prior approval.

requests.text: Could I get a 27-inch 4K monitor for my home office?

expected.reason: Annual budget $500; only the $120 webcam (2026-03-10) falls in the last 12 months, so $380 remains. The monitor costs exactly $380.

requests.text: Could I expense a sit-stand desk? My back has been bothering me.

expected.reason: First-year designer budget $2,500; $1,980 already spent, $520 left. The desk costs $600.

requests.text: Can I get an ergonomic chair for my internship? My kitchen chair is killing me.

expected.reason: Intern budget covers electronic desk items only.

requests.text: I'm contracting with the platform team through Brightpath. Can BEEHIVE send me a company laptop?

expected.reason: Contractor laptops are an exception needing IT + Security approval.

requests.text: Also, I need a security key to log in to Okta.

expected.reason: Contractors may have 1 security key; none on file.

requests.text: I lost one of my YubiKeys on the train this morning. Can you ship me a replacement?

expected.reason: Both keys still show as active, so the loss hasn't been reported. The lost key must be revoked before a replacement ships.

requests.text: Following up on my lost YubiKey from last week. Security said I can order a replacement now.

expected.reason: One key is marked reported_lost (2026-11-20); 1 active key, max is 2.

requests.text: I think I left my laptop in an Uber last night. The driver isn't answering. What do I do, and can I get a new one?

expected.reason: Lost laptop is a security incident: report within 24 hours, police report within 72 hours if stolen, remote wipe.

requests.text: My laptop screen cracked and it won't boot past the logo. I'm on call this week so I need a replacement ASAP.

expected.reason: Broken laptops go through the replacement program; IT assesses repair vs replace.

requests.text: I need a second laptop running Linux to test our agent on a clean machine.

expected.reason: A second device needs a business justification plus manager and IT approval.

requests.text: My last day is December 4th. Am I able to keep my laptop?

expected.reason: Laptop in use since 2024-03-18 (32 months, at least 12). Kept at no cost after IT wipes it.

requests.text: I'm leaving at the end of the month. Can I keep the MacBook Air?

expected.reason: In use since 2026-02-10 (9 months, under 12). Can't keep it free, but can buy it at current net value.

requests.text: Tomorrow is my last day. I've had this laptop over two years, so I can keep it, right?

expected.reason: The keep option is void when someone leaves for cause, even though the laptop is 30 months old.

requests.text: I'm on leave until January but my laptop is ancient. Can you have a new one ready when I'm back?

expected.reason: Employee is on leave until 2027-01-11; requests are held for review.

requests.text: New here! Need a laptop and a monitor please.

expected.reason: Employee ID not found.
